 By Chicago Bulls Central via www.youtube.com, 11/10/2026 Matas Buzelis responded when the Chicago Bulls needed it. After criticism surrounding his early-season play, Matas finished with 19 points, 5 rebounds, 2 assists and a block against Philadelphia while shooting 6-of-10 from the field. But Haize believes the Bulls need to go even further. Give Matas defined responsibilities. Use him as a screener. Let him attack switches. Get him working with Caleb Wilson. Put the young Bulls in positions where they have to READ and react to NBA defenses. The talent is there. Now it's about development. 👇 Bulls Nation, should Matas Buzelis get MORE late-game responsibility? 🎙️ Chicago...
